decisions.reason: The organic sliced salami platter got only a brief mention on the website, which suggests weaker emphasis, but organic cold cuts fit the firm's core range and usually get more than one year to prove themselves in retail listings.
The organic poultry mini salami snack has its own product page and targets the growing organic, poultry and snacking trends, so the firm is likely to keep backing it.
The premium sharing snack has its own page and fits the strong demand for salami snacks, a segment where German sausage makers are investing, so dropping it after one year is unlikely.
